steps.description: The goal is to open the OKX Web3 homepage. The current page is about:blank with no elements, so the next step is to navigate to the required URL.

The user wants to click the left‑top '行情' link after loading the OKX Web3 homepage. On the current screen the '行情' link is represented by the element with ID hexa-2. Clicking this will navigate to the token market page, fulfilling the next step of the goal.

The user has navigated to the token list page and clicked the '行情' tab. The next step is to enter the detail page of the first token shown. In the current screen, the first token link appears to be the 'Punch' token with ID hexa-45. Clicking this link will open its detail page, fulfilling the next part of the goal.

We are on the token detail page after clicking the first coin. The next goal step is to check the '我已知晓交易风险' checkbox before starting trade. The label element with text '我已知晓交易风险' has ID hexa-148, so we click it.

The user wants to proceed after acknowledging the risk. The next required step is to click the '开始交易' button to start trading. The current screen shows a button with text '开始交易' and ID hexa-149. Clicking this will advance to the next step of connecting a wallet.
The user wants to click '连接钱包' after having already clicked '开始交易'. The current screen shows a button with text '连接钱包' (ID hexa-160). Clicking this button is the next required step.
